Nucleus.title: Nucleus
Nucleus.description: Represents a core entity within BindNexus, identifiable by an ID and name, and can be associated with bind codes and operations. It can have an AI-generated description and tags.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Nucleus entity.

name.description: The human-readable name of the Nucleus.

description.description: An optional, concise description of the Nucleus, potentially AI-generated based on its name or purpose.

tags.description: An optional list of relevant tags for the Nucleus, potentially AI-generated.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the Nucleus was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the Nucleus was last updated.

BindCode.title: BindCode
BindCode.description: Represents a unique alphanumeric bind code generated by the system, including its status, associated metadata, and linkage to a Nucleus.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BindCode entity.

code.description: The actual unique alphanumeric bind code (e.g., 'XXXX' in ':bind XXXX').

description.description: An optional description or purpose for the bind code.

expirationDate.description: An optional timestamp indicating when the bind code expires.

status.description: The current status of the bind code (e.g., 'active', 'used', 'expired').

nucleusId.description: Reference to the Nucleus entity this bind code is associated with. (Relationship: Nucleus 1:N BindCode)

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the BindCode was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the BindCode was last updated.

BindOperation.title: BindOperation
BindOperation.description: Tracks a chronological log of all bind-related operations, linking them to a specific Nucleus and BindCode, and recording their status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BindOperation entity.

nucleusId.description: Reference to the Nucleus entity involved in this operation. (Relationship: Nucleus 1:N BindOperation)

bindCodeId.description: Reference to the BindCode entity used or affected by this operation. (Relationship: BindCode 1:N BindOperation)

timestamp.description: The exact date and time when this bind operation occurred.

status.description: The status of the bind operation (e.g., 'pending', 'sent', 'confirmed', 'failed').

operationDetails.description: Additional details or context about the bind operation, such as specific actions or error messages.

definition.description: Collection of Nucleus entities, where each Nucleus is owned by a specific user. The 'ownerId' field, matching the '{userId}' in the path, is denormalized within each Nucleus document for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this Nucleus.

params.name: nucleusId
params.description: The unique identifier for the Nucleus entity.

definition.description: Subcollection of BindCode entities, each associated with a specific Nucleus. The 'ownerId' field (matching the Nucleus owner) and 'nucleusId' are denormalized into each BindCode document for authorization independence and query efficiency.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the parent Nucleus.

params.name: nucleusId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent Nucleus entity.

params.name: bindCodeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the BindCode entity.

definition.description: Subcollection of BindOperation entities, logging operations for a specific BindCode under a Nucleus. The 'ownerId' (matching the Nucleus owner), 'nucleusId', and 'bindCodeId' are denormalized for authorization independence and contextual queries.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the grandparent Nucleus.

params.name: nucleusId
params.description: The unique identifier for the grandparent Nucleus entity.

params.name: bindCodeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent BindCode entity.

params.name: operationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the BindOperation entity.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure prioritizes Authorization Independence and Query-Aware Security Rules (QAPs) by implementing a user-centric, hierarchical ownership model with strategic denormalization. All core entities (Nucleus, BindCode, BindOperation) are nested under a user's document, establishing clear ownership from the path itself (e.g., '/users/{userId}/nuclei/{nucleusId}'). This path-based ownership makes it straightforward to write security rules that check 'request.auth.uid == userId' at the collection group level.

To achieve **Authorization Independence (CRITICAL)** and eliminate the need for `get()` calls in security rules, the `ownerId` (derived from the user who created the Nucleus) is explicitly denormalized into every `Nucleus`, `BindCode`, and `BindOperation` document. This means a `BindCode` document, even though nested under a `Nucleus`, will contain its own `ownerId` field (which matches the `ownerId` of its parent Nucleus and the `userId` in its path). Similarly, a `BindOperation` document will also contain `ownerId`.

This denormalization ensures that any security rule, regardless of the document's depth, can verify ownership by simply checking `request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerId`. This makes rules highly performant, atomic (no cross-document reads for authorization during transactions or batch writes), and easy to debug. It also directly supports **QAPs** because list operations on collections like `/users/{userId}/nuclei` will inherently be filtered by the `userId` in the path, and further authenticated by the `ownerId` in each document. This ensures that a user can only query for and receive data they are authorized to access, without relying on complex, inefficient server-side filtering logic within rules. Structural segregation is maintained by ensuring all documents within these user-specific subcollections share the same security posture – single-user ownership.
